skill.name: Unity
skill.description: Avoid common Unity mistakes — lifecycle ordering, GetComponent caching, physics timing, and Unity's fake null.
skill.summary: Lifecycle Order - `Awake` before `Start` — use Awake for self-init, Start for cross-references - `OnEnable` called before `Start` — but after `Awake` - Order between scripts not guaranteed — use Script Execution Order if
